author: claude-code-assistant

unchanged: stand topology A-R-B over two veth links

hypothesis: Delivery and reverse receipts depend on the sole authorized A-R-B Ethernet path and on node keys and policies read from the live Sepolia registry at a finalized block; a registry change stops delivery once a node observes the finalized block containing it; no IP fallback or replacement message ID is used.

state_source.reader: lightclient/bcp02/light.py against a local Helios 0.12.0 verifying light client (BCP 0.2-LC); until 2026-11-05 read mode V with an own Geth + Lighthouse pair
state_source.binding: actual contract addresses, runtime Keccak-256, loopback endpoint, Helios weak-subjectivity checkpoint, execution bootstrap, Helios binary SHA-256 and its declared upstreams, fixed before the run
state_source.delivery_to_nodes: the same local state-provider interface as NET-001-F; only its source changes
state_source.state_channel: a separate state-reader namespace asks Helios on loopback; Helios reaches public Sepolia RPC over HTTPS and verifies every answer with proofs; node namespaces keep no IP address, route or AF_INET socket

refresh_period_finding.observed: with lodestar-sepolia.chainsafe.io the Helios head advanced after 384 s in the one full interval measured, and eth_syncing was false for about 32 s of it, so the adapter cannot refresh every 300 s
refresh_period_finding.estimate: the finalized block was 815 s old at the read; one interval adds about 384 s, so state stays under 1800 s with reads in each window and about one missed window, from one read only

contracts.choice: owner decision: reuse the REG-001 run 6 deployment (runtime already verified) or deploy afresh with the same build

before_window.purpose: register A, R, B with this run's fresh public keys and establish the declared policies
before_window.effective: only after the finalized snapshot C containing all of them is accepted in read mode LC

inside_window.call: TransitPolicy.withdraw on the forward edge R->B
ConnectionPolicy.withdraw on the reverse connection B->A

transactions.keys: private keys stay with the operator outside Git; node private keys are fresh per run and never on chain

timing.rationale: REG-001 R4: a registry change becomes effective for a finalized reader after 14.2-19.0 min (median 16.5). NET-001-F deadlines assume an instantly published fixture state.
timing.deadlines_start_at: the node's first observation of the finalized snapshot L containing the change, not the transaction submission
timing.measured: submit -> inclusion -> finalized -> reader acceptance -> first node rejection, per change
timing.N08_live: block the light client's upstream endpoints at the stand firewall as a declared barrier: STATE_UNAVAILABLE on the next required read, then STATE_STALE once the cached snapshot exceeds 1800 s; the wait counts as a finality-type wait

route_constraints.directed_edges: A->R, R->A, R->B, B->R as registered in this run
route_constraints.directed_connections: A->B, B->A as registered in this run

cases: IPVX-BCP02-NET-001-F cases P01-N11 with identical oracles and success metrics; stimuli N06, N07 and N08 use real registry transactions and a real endpoint block instead of fixture banks; every result carries state_mode=sepolia-finalized-snapshot and the snapshot block hash

additional_measurement.statement: end-to-end time from a registry transaction to the first refused BCP frame

prerequisites.item: Helios 0.12.0 installed on the stand with an explicit checkpoint (VALIDATOR-001 and relcom-infra PR854 closed 2026-11-05: no separate VM); the temporary instance of REG-001-LC was removed

current state of the REG-001 run 6 contracts read in mode LC with zero transactions and equal to S4 plus the 20 setKeys writes of the R4 series (experiments/bcp02-reg-001-lc); closes R1 and accepts the mode (S1-S3 are older than the light client window)
the snapshot refresh rule reconciled with the readable window of the light client (state_source.refresh_period_finding)
NET-001-F components implemented, reviewed and NET-001-F run first
L-only components: per-run registry writer, live state-reader binding, finality-wait scheduler, firewall barrier for N08
stand VM (IPVX-BCP02-STAND-001) with outbound HTTPS for the light client only
owner permit for up to 24 Sepolia transactions per run, window and step list

does_not_establish: an IP-free whole device: the light client uses IP to reach public RPC
finality beyond the sync committee and the light client trust boundary
